applications.name: AIPA Agent Harness
applications.title: AIPA Agent Harness
applications.description: Agent runtime derived from OpenBB agent-rita. Handles AskAgent, stages fdc3.data.file, bridges AG-UI over PrivateChannel to CopilotRuntime, and executes generic FDC3 Desktop Agent tools under harness identity.

AskAgent.purpose: Start an AI agent session that plans and calls FDC3 tools; result is a PrivateChannel of fdc3.ai.agui.* AG-UI envelopes.
